open_points.subject: K-11 surface vs M22 spooled-file reading
open_points.text: K-11: "The kernel exposes one fixed set of typed operations over `mcp`: inspect, author, try, run, resume, read traces, and the owner's approve, accept, activate, grant, revoke, resolve and cancel." / M22: "...the owner's inspection read of its bytes (A10 rule 2; the State 5 operation `read_spooled_file`)"
open_points.question: Is `read_spooled_file` a distinct MCP operation, or must spooled-file byte reading be expressed only through the already-listed fixed operations?
options: `read_spooled_file` is a separate MCP operation (so K-11 list must be expanded)
spooled-file bytes are read via `inspect`/`read traces` payload shapes, not a new operation
spooled-file bytes are not exposed at all in this kernel
open_points.default_guess: treat spooled-file byte reading as part of `inspect` so K-11 stays literally fixed

open_points.subject: M25 StandingGrant applicability by effect class
open_points.text: M25: "A grant never covers a `destructive` node."
open_points.question: Can a standing grant be created for `read` or `draft-write` operation nodes (which do not stop for owner approval), or only for node classes that can actually wait for approval (`state-transition`, `external-effect`)?
options: allow grants for any non-`destructive` operation node
allow grants only for `state-transition` and `external-effect` nodes
refuse grants for nodes that would never ask approval
open_points.default_guess: allow any non-`destructive` node, because that is the only explicit prohibition

open_points.subject: M28 Installation change application
open_points.text: M28: "the configuration is read at start; the token list is read again whenever it has changed"
open_points.question: For configuration fields other than tokens (for example `service_instances`, `manifest_revision`, listen address), do changes take effect without restart or only on restart?
options: only token changes are hot-reloaded; all other fields require restart
all installation fields are reloaded dynamically
open_points.default_guess: only token changes are reloaded; other configuration changes require restart

open_points.subject: M28 service instance selection vs M11 binding lifecycle
open_points.text: M28: "a service with none selected is not invocable"
open_points.question: When no instance is selected for a service, are proposing/accepting bindings for its operations allowed, or must they be refused?
options: allow propose/accept; invocation is refused until an instance is selected
refuse proposal as manifest mismatch when no instance is selected
allow proposal but refuse acceptance until an instance is selected
open_points.default_guess: allow propose/accept and block only invocation
